about.headline: We believe links should be
about.description: Uurl was built to democratize link management. No subscriptions, no hidden limits — just powerful tools for everyone, free forever.
about.storyP1: Every URL shortener on the market either caps your links, hides analytics behind a paywall, or charges a monthly fee that just keeps climbing. We knew there had to be a better way.
about.storyP2: So we built Uurl — a modern, blazing-fast link management platform that stays free forever. No tricks, no enterprise plans, no features locked behind paywalls. Just honest, powerful tools for creators, marketers, and developers.
about.storyP3: Today, Uurl powers over 10 million links for thousands of teams worldwide — from solo creators to Fortune 500 companies.
about.missionDesc: To make link management accessible to everyone by providing powerful, reliable, and completely free tools that help people understand and optimize their online presence.
about.visionDesc: A world where understanding your links is as simple as creating them — where data empowers decisions without corporate gatekeeping or expensive subscriptions.
about.valuePrivacyDesc: We believe your data belongs to you. No tracking, no selling — just transparent analytics you control.
about.valueSpeedDesc: Every millisecond counts. Our infrastructure is optimized for sub-50ms redirects worldwide.
about.valueGlobalDesc: Free for everyone, everywhere. No credit card required, no limits, no hidden fees.
about.valueDataDesc: Every click tells a story. We give you the insights you need to make smarter decisions.
about.ctaDesc: Join thousands of teams who trust Uurl for their link management.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: At Uurl, we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our URL shortening service.
privacy.section1Item1: Account Information: When you sign up, we collect your name and email address to create and manage your account.
privacy.section1Item2: Link Data: We store the original URLs you shorten, along with analytics data such as click counts, geographic locations, referrers, and device information.
privacy.section1Item3: Usage Data: We automatically collect information about how you interact with our service, including pages visited, features used, and session duration.
privacy.section1Item4: Cookies: We use essential cookies to maintain your session and optional analytics cookies to improve our service (you can disable these).
privacy.section2Item1: To provide, maintain, and improve our URL shortening and analytics services.
privacy.section2Item2: To display click analytics and insights for the links you create.
privacy.section2Item3: To communicate with you about service updates, security alerts, and support inquiries.
privacy.section2Item4: To detect, prevent, and address fraudulent or abusive usage of our platform.
privacy.section3Item1: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Period.
privacy.section3Item2: We may share anonymized, aggregated data (e.g., total click counts) for service improvement purposes.
privacy.section3Item3: We may disclose your data if required by law or to protect our legal rights.
privacy.section3Item4: We use third-party cloud infrastructure providers (e.g., AWS) to host our service, who are contractually bound to protect your data.
privacy.section4Item1: Essential Cookies: Required for the service to function (session management, authentication).
privacy.section4Item2: Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how you use the platform so we can improve it.
privacy.section4Item3: You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings at any time.
privacy.section4Item4: We do not use cookies for third-party advertising or tracking across other websites.
privacy.section5Item1: We use industry-standard encryption (TLS/SSL) for all data in transit.
privacy.section5Item2: Passwords are hashed and salted using bcrypt — we never store plain-text passwords.
privacy.section5Item3: Regular security audits and penetration testing are performed on our infrastructure.
privacy.section5Item4: We maintain strict access controls to any systems containing personal data.
privacy.section6Item1: Access: You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
privacy.section6Item2: Correction: You can update your account information at any time through your settings.
privacy.section6Item3: Deletion: You can delete your account and all associated data at any time.
privacy.section6Item4: Portability: You can request your data in a machine-readable format.
privacy.section6Item5: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@uurl.uz.
privacy.ctaDesc: If you have any questions or concerns about this privacy policy or how we handle your data, don't hesitate to reach out.
